note: Recorded distribution decisions. A value of null with status "undecided" means nobody has decided; tooling must not treat it as any particular answer. Questions refer to the expert question list (Q1-Q17) kept with the release records. Changing a decision is a reviewed change to this file.

libbpf_license_option.effect: Recorded in the license bundle inventory only. The bundle ships the owning package's complete Debian copyright file and the common-licenses texts it references, whichever option is chosen.

libelf_license_option.effect: Recorded in the license bundle inventory only.

ship_link_inputs_asset.effect: true: the release also carries bpfcompat-validator-link-inputs-linux-amd64.tar.gz (every static archive and start file the validator was linked from). The relink kit (main.o, commands, trace, map, build record) ships regardless.

ship_native_sources_asset.effect: true: the release also carries bpfcompat-validator-native-sources.tar (the exact Ubuntu source packages in distribution/native-sources.lock, hash-verified).

native_notice_scope.effect: None today: the bundle ships each owning package's complete Debian copyright file verbatim, plus the linker's exact member list.

delivery_channels.effect: None today: the full bundle is delivered as a release asset, by install.sh and by the Action's prebuilt path; the container image carries the CLI's Go texts (it has no validator).

prerelease_with_open_decisions.effect: Not enforced by tooling. A stable build refuses while any decision marked blocks_stable is undecided.
